name: Deepfake Artifact Detection
description: Detects face-swapping and deepfake blending artifacts in video frames.
useCase: Identifying face-swap deepfakes through boundary blending analysis
mechanism: Analyzes the transition zone between the swapped face region and the original frame, detecting unnatural boundary gradients and smooth interior textures characteristic of face replacement algorithms.
source: Li et al. (2020) - Face X-ray, CVPR
algorithm: Face Boundary Analysis + Interior Texture Consistency
parameters: Block size: adaptive, Analysis region: face/body, Metrics: gradient energy, variance ratio
strengths:
- Effective for detecting AI-generated video artifacts
- Works across different video resolutions
- Complements other forensic analysis methods
- Low computational overhead per frame
limitations:
- Requires video input (not applicable to images)
- May produce false positives on heavily processed videos
- Performance varies with video quality
- Single-frame analysis limits temporal assessment

references.title: Li et al. (2020) - Face X-ray, CVPR
